answer_fixes.reason: Physical access control = cameras/facilities; console password is logical access.
Valid set is enable secret + line passwords with login; 'enable secret privilege 15' is invalid syntax.
Perfect Forward Secrecy is a WPA3 feature, not WEP.
Controller↔applications is northbound; REST is appropriate; OpenFlow is southbound.
L3 switches route between VLANs (inter-VLAN routing).
SSID identifies a wireless network for clients, not a wired network.
After dynamic interface + auth server, next basic step is create WLAN and bind the interface.
WLC console is out-of-band management via asynchronous serial, not IP.
Lightweight AP in local mode typically uses an access port on the AP management VLAN.
FHRP protects against default gateway failure, not STP loops.
QoS marking changes the ToS field (DSCP/IPP); checksum may be recalculated but is not the marking field.
